name: Harmons Neighborhood Grocer (Draper / Daybreak / Bangerter) Kitchen Rotisserie Chicken, Sushi & Soup Bar
brandOrRestaurant: Harmons Neighborhood Grocer (Draper / South Jordan / Daybreak, UT)
whyItWorks: Minutes from both TownePlace Suites Draper (Bangerter Crossing) and Holiday Inn Express Herriman/South Jordan (Daybreak/District), Harmons has a scratch kitchen offering hot Chicken Noodle Soup, plain Rotisserie Chicken, fresh-made California/Salmon sushi rolls, and authentic long-fermented Artisan Sourdough bread.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Grab a cup of hot Homemade Chicken Noodle Soup, a fresh Salmon Avocado Roll or Rotisserie Chicken breast, and a loaf of Harmons Artisan Sourdough bread to keep in your hotel room toaster.
watchOuts: Avoid spicy chili, broccoli cheddar soup (unless taking lactase), and seeded multigrain breads
